n331BoundedQuestion: Can one small reusable excavator export prove that all authority-required function-generated runtime objects and actions reconstruct offline while teacher/reference bytes, legacy assets and baked production meshes remain outside the package?
realFeedback: The user asked to save the current pure-function excavator as a small reusable file, including its actions, without old teacher/reference assets.

existingCoverage: N286 bounded function replay separated from source-fidelity replay
N330 authority-owned action inventory and behavior-graph parity
deduplication.newFailureMechanism: An export can be small and start offline yet silently omit actions or functional components, or relabel bundled teacher/legacy/baked bytes as generated inputs. Existing gates do not bind these facts into one export-subject receipt.

deliveryReceipt.provenanceBoundary: A compact provenance record may name or link the teacher/reference source; the source image/model/PDF bytes themselves are not export payload.

independentCleanRoomObservation.environment: empty cache; no repository checkout; network disabled

auditRules: The Producer cannot define or shrink the required object or action inventories.
Small file size is not evidence of function generation, completeness or rights cleanliness.
The label pure-function is not evidence; independent static payload scanning and runtime input observation are required.
Every expected runtime object must have a same-run generator birth record from manifest-bound function source and parameters.
Every expected action must reconstruct into the authority-bound behavior graph; dropping action code to reduce package size is a HOLD.
Teacher/reference and legacy asset bytes are excluded from payload, but provenance metadata is retained.
All runtime-opened inputs must be manifest-bound and pre-authorized; no network, stale workspace path or hidden cache may satisfy the replay.
Two cold reconstructions must agree on object inventory, action graph and generated geometry output digests.
A qualitative request for a small file does not authorize an invented numeric budget; maxExportBytes remains UNKNOWN until authority-owned.

teacher.reason: N285/N286/N308/N309/N328/N330 already supply the needed clean-room, dependency, exclusion, inventory and action-graph principles; this round makes their combination executable for one new user export failure.

rollback: Delete the N331 candidate-only files; no main, R2 OS, production Mother, public Site or production asset is changed.
